---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What problem would this solve? What are you trying to do today that's hard or
impossible?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see. Be as concrete as you can.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about, and why they fall short.

## Additional context

Mockups, links, or examples from other apps. Note if this should stay
**local-first** (no cloud/outbound dependencies), which is a core project goal.
